findings.R01: Every question must be graded automatically by Untangle The Nexus: no person judges wording, drawings or work. Short answers that only a person (or exact wording) could grade became multiple choice or true/false; every remaining short answer got one answer line per part, the precision or form in the question, and a key the game's answer checker accepts
findings.R02: Statistics: each question states its own model and conventions (null model, tail, 5% cutoff, the 2-standard-deviation margin of error, independence, fair devices) and never treats a common result as proof
findings.R03: Specific mathematical corrections named in the review (values, domains, restrictions, wording)
findings.R04: Missing information: the question now states every given it needs, so it stands alone
findings.R05: Coverage: a focused step-function set (HSF-IF.C.7.b) and set titles that match the assessed response
findings.R06: Grading notes of reasoning items now say what is wrong with each other choice
findings.R07: Multiple-choice length cue removed: other choices were rewritten with specific errors so that the correct choice is not much longer than every other choice
findings.R08: Other wording or choice revisions found while rewriting (conditions stated, a second defensible answer removed)

rules: IDs of corrected questions are kept (status revised).
An ID whose skill or standard changes is retired and never reused; the replacement questions get new IDs (status new).
Sets added after publication take the next free set number; branches added to an existing set take the next free branch number. Numbers need not be consecutive.
